name: LCW World Heavyweight Championship
notes: The federation's own Title Holders and Title Histories index (promotions/lcw/archive/lcw-title-histories-index.html) linked this belt's own ledger to a pop-up window that was never captured anywhere in the surviving record. The two reigns held here are cross-referenced from the served show corpus itself — a card and two characters' own already-registered tenures — not from any ledger.
epitaph: LCW's flagship singles title survives in the record at exactly one hinge point: Pheonyx held it into the Thursday Tempest card of 9 August 2001, defending it against Gravity with a special guest referee, and lost it to Rook Black on the Torn pay-per-view of 3 September 2001 — the same show that split the federation into Mercury and Evo. Both men were fired from LCW the same night, and Rook Black carried the belt with him into the angle half. No earlier or later reign survives in the held record; who Pheonyx beat for it, and how long he held it, is not recoverable.
